theorems.statement: ∀ (E F : IntermediateField ℚ (AlgebraicClosure ℚ)) [FiniteDimensional ℚ E] [FiniteDimensional ℚ F] (hEF : E ≤ F) (ℓ : ℕ), ℓ.Prime → ∀ (V : ValuationSubring E), V.LiesOverPrime ℓ → ∃ W : ValuationSubring F, W.LiesOverPrime ℓ ∧ ∀ x : E, IntermediateField.inclusion hEF x ∈ W ↔ x ∈ V
